# CLI Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-cli-reference.mjs. DO NOT EDIT. -->

This reference is generated from Commander metadata for InfraEnv `0.2.0-alpha.0`. A listed command may still require a capability advertised by the active Supervisor. In particular, general Playground PTY attach, external S3 connect/load, and generic fault mutation are unavailable in this alpha and fail explicitly.

## infraenv

```text
Usage: infraenv [options] [command]

Portable AI infrastructure learning and S2 simulation runtime

Options:
  -V, --version                                output the version number
  --json                                       emit machine-readable JSON where applicable
  -h, --help                                   display help for command

Commands:
  doctor                                       Check the local runtime prerequisites
  lab                                          List, start, manage and submit labs
  nodes
  jobs
  metrics <group>
  inspect <node>
  diagnose
  fault                                        Manage course-v1 and capability-gated Environment faults
  debug:docker-args                            Print the active sidecar security posture
  supervisor                                   Run and inspect the host-local v0.2 Supervisor
  environment|env                              Create and manage versioned Environment documents
  snapshot                                     Inspect immutable Environment snapshots
  instance                                     Start and control Environment instances
  checkpoint                                   Capture and restore deterministic local learning state
  node                                         Select the active simulated node context
  top [options]                                Show simulated node pressure and accelerator utilization
  nvitop [options]                             Render a simulated accelerator process view
  nvidia-smi [options]                         Render simulated NVIDIA-compatible inventory and metrics
  topology [options]                           Show the current node hardware graph
  bench [options] [group]                      Run a deterministic simulated hbm, p2p, collective, storage, or all benchmark
  shell [options] <environmentId>              Open a real PTY when the selected instance exposes that capability
  exec [options] <environmentId> <command...>  Run an allowlisted command on one node, or every modeled node with --all
  webui|ui [options] [environmentId]           Ensure a foreground loopback Supervisor and launch its one-time Web UI URL
  template                                     Inspect curriculum-owned presets/templates
  device                                       Inspect devices from an immutable HardwareGraph snapshot
  link                                         Inspect topology links and modeled health
  storage                                      Inspect modeled storage and request optional storage capabilities
  help [command]                               display help for command
```

## infraenv environment

```text
Usage: infraenv environment|env [options] [command]

Create and manage versioned Environment documents

Options:
  -h, --help                               display help for command

Commands:
  create [options] <source>                Create from a JSON file, or create <name> with template or hardware options
  list                                     List active and stopped Environments
  show <environmentId>                     Show one Environment document
  delete <environmentId>                   Move an Environment to recoverable trash
  restore <environmentId>                  Restore an Environment from trash
  purge [options] <environmentId>          Permanently remove a trashed Environment
  export [options] <environmentId> <file>  Export an Environment, snapshots and checkpoints as a portable bundle
  import [options] <file>                  Verify and import a portable Environment bundle
  snapshot [options] <environmentId>       Create an immutable deterministic snapshot
  start [options] <environmentId>          Start the Environment through the Supervisor
  stop <environmentId>                     Stop the active instance of an Environment
  restart <environmentId>                  Restart the active Environment instance
  reset <environmentId>                    Reset an Environment instance to its deterministic snapshot
  apply [options] <environmentId> <file>   Apply an updated Environment document through optimistic registry validation
  clone <environmentId> <name>             Clone an Environment under a new immutable ID namespace
  use [options] <environmentId>            Select an Environment and its active instance as the CLI context
  checkpoint                               Manage checkpoints for this Environment
  help [command]                           display help for command
```
